question.problem:
$$
∃{\,z}_{\begin{aligned} \\ ↑ \\ \text{I}\end{aligned}}\in Q,\,z\cdot {k}_{\begin{aligned} \\ ↑ \\ \text{II}\end{aligned}}\le {w}_{\begin{aligned} \\ ↑ \\ \text{III}\end{aligned}}+1
$$

Which occurrences of the variables in the expression above are free?
question.worked_solution:
Let's examine our expression and mark the occurrences of the variables as bound $(\text{b})$ or free $(\text{f}).$

- Occurrence I of the variable $z$ is *bound* since it's placed right next to the quantifier $∃:$

$$
∃{z}_{\begin{aligned} \\ ↑ \\ \text{b}\end{aligned}}\in Q,\,z\cdot k\le w+1
$$

- Occurrence II of the variable $k$ is *free* since it isn't placed right next to a quantifier and it doesn't lie within the scope of a quantifier that uses $k.$

- Occurrence III of the variable $w$ is *free* since it isn't placed right next to a quantifier and it doesn't lie within the scope of a quantifier that uses $w.$

The occurrences of variables in the expression are as follows:

$$
∃{z}_{\begin{aligned} \\ ↑ \\ \text{b}\end{aligned}}\in Q,\,z\cdot {k}_{\begin{aligned} \\ ↑ \\ \text{f}\end{aligned}}\le {w}_{\begin{aligned} \\ ↑ \\ \text{f}\end{aligned}}+1
$$

Therefore, the free occurrences are "II and III only."
